summary: PR-1846 changes only payments session.py, raising bearer-token entropy from 24 to 32 bytes in its second commit. The ticket, independent code review on the head commit, and CI on the head commit (including the SES-1 control test) all check out. However, session.py is security-sensitive and the only security review was approved on the first commit, 1e0a30c. The later behaviour-changing commit voids that approval, so CHG-5 is not met and the change is rejected until a security review of 7b03646 is recorded.
